I naturally gravitate towards people who are open-hearted, generous of spirit and self aware. Most of the people I am surrounded by are making a positive difference in the world or are on a spiritual or personal growth journey of some kind.

I value heart felt, emotionally intimate connections with friends and associates. I enjoy people. I love going out listening to music, theatre and dancing. I am fit, eat heathily, don't work too hard these days and appreciate being outdoors in nature.

I will always remember my first day in Paris because I was awestruck by the beauty all around me plus I always feel romantic when I am in Paris. Needless to say, romantic comedy is one of my favourite film genres.

I used to be an adrenaline junkie but I am so pleased to say that gone are the days of busyness, gone are the days of being addicted to activity and stress and gone are the days of covering up feelings of not being good enough with over achievement. Phew!! That's a relief. 

Today, my life is peaceful, joyful and mostly serene and whilst there are some limits, I have managed to achieve a certain amount of freedom about how I spend each day. 

One of my philisophies on life is, "People do the best they can in any given moment. And whilst at times that best may not feel so great, it is that person's best in that moment."

I am also mindful that we only have 168 hours in each week and that doesn't seem like many hours to me so I make sure that I live my life in joy as much as I possibly can.

neighborhood_overview: Seddon is a great place and growing by the minute but is still quiet and retains its village like atmosphere. There's great cafes and fantastic coffee,a gourmet supermarket,wine shop and a variety of restaurants from African (my favourite!) to Malaysian and Italian,and all within walking distance to the property. Just down the road is Footscray,a predominately Vietnamese community with a bit of African too,so wonderful food choices everywhere,including the Footscray Market with its fresh fruit and veg,meat and seafood. Seddon also has an eclectic mix of shops ranging from gifts shops like Sedonia to vintage shops like my very own "Once More With Feeling" at the front of the property on Charles St. So you must drop in and say hi when you stay! Its a great friendly neighbourhood that you will fall in love with and not far from the city either or major attractions like Flemington Racecourse and Etihad stadium. Leave your car and take public transport or an Uber, it's that easy.

I love music and feel so lucky to live in Melbourne where we have a great live music scene. Sometimes i sing and play guitar and I love both country and western music,I also sing in the Melbourne Mass Gospel choir. My partner is Ray,who is a builder and is responsible for the wonderful renovation at Seddon and who sometimes builds sets for the theatre too. I started StayCentral Melbourne Corporate Apartments with one apartment, and now manage multiple properties in many different locations in inner Melbourne.

Like many of my guests, I love to travel; both overseas to places like the Mulu Caves in Borneo, ancient cities (in many old countries), Antarctica & Alaska, Patagonia, and colourful markets in amazing places like Pha Long in Vietnam, Jaisalmer in India, Tozeur in Tunisia & La Paz in Bolivia. I also love short domestic trips for weekends away just to relax. 

It means I get to be on the other side of the counter, and experience how other people look after their guests: and I take their good ideas back with me. 

I even worked as a part-time tourist guide in Melbourne for a couple of years when I arrived here, and really enjoyed the interactions with the tourists off the huge cruise liners that appear in Melbourne each spring and summer. I have tried to extend this experience into my accommodation business here in Melbourne, where I really love assisting people with their stays. You only need to read some of the 1,000 plus reviews on Airbnb, Trip Advisor, Goo gle, and on my own StayCentral Melbourne Corporate Apartments website to realise how much our guests enjoy our apartments, and the way we look after them. 

I do love living in Melbourne. It enjoys a unique place in Australia. It is often described as the cultural, business, shopping and sporting capital of the country. The restaurants and cafes in Melbourne are amongst the best in the world. I love living in an urban village amongst these, and all the other everyday shops; and jumping on a tram and avoiding the hassles of traffic. It is a city of great opportunity, experiences, events and lifestyle that can be enjoyed by locals and visitors alike; and I really enjoy facilitating our guests' stays here.

I do hope I have the opportunity to help you get to know Melbourne and grow to love it as I have. If you have any questions about StayCentral Melbourne Corporate Apartments, please feel free to call me on (Phone number hidden by Airbnb) during business hours, and I will do my best to help you.

I started StayCentral Melbourne Corporate Apartments with one apartment, and now manage multiple properties in many different locations in inner Melbourne.

Like many of my guests, I love to travel; both overseas to places like the Mulu Caves in Borneo, ancient cities (in many old countries), Antarctica & Alaska, Patagonia, and colourful markets in amazing places like Pha Long in Vietnam, Jaisalmer in India, Tozeur in Tunisia & La Paz in Bolivia. I also love short domestic trips for weekends away just to relax. 

It means I get to be on the other side of the counter, and experience how other people look after their guests: and I take their good ideas back with me. 

I even worked as a part-time tourist guide in Melbourne for a couple of years when I arrived here, and really enjoyed the interactions with the tourists off the huge cruise liners that appear in Melbourne each spring and summer. I have tried to extend this experience into my accommodation business here in Melbourne, where I really love assisting people with their stays. You only need to read some of the 1,000 plus reviews on Airbnb, Trip Advisor, Goo gle, and on my own StayCentral Melbourne Corporate Apartments website to realise how much our guests enjoy our apartments, and the way we look after them. 

I do love living in Melbourne. It enjoys a unique place in Australia. It is often described as the cultural, business, shopping and sporting capital of the country. The restaurants and cafes in Melbourne are amongst the best in the world. I love living in an urban village amongst these, and all the other everyday shops; and jumping on a tram and avoiding the hassles of traffic. It is a city of great opportunity, experiences, events and lifestyle that can be enjoyed by locals and visitors alike; and I really enjoy facilitating our guests' stays here.

I do hope I have the opportunity to help you get to know Melbourne and grow to love it as I have. If you have any questions about StayCentral Melbourne Corporate Apartments, please feel free to call me on (Phone number hidden by Airbnb) during business hours, and I will do my best to help you.

 With so much suffering on this planet I figure that if I can give one animal a perfect life then I'm doing something good.

host_about:
YOUR HOST: GARY COPOLOV 

Hello, my name is Gary and I live in Middle Park, Melbourne.

I currently manage over twenty inner bay side short to long term accommodation properties located in Middle Park, Albert Park, South Melbourne, Port Melbourne, St.Kilda, Balaclava, Elwood and even one property in North Carlton and Torquay.

Those in the "hood" know that these locations are arguably some of Melbourne’s best and most desirable inner-city suburbs. I believe I am fortunate to live and manage properties in the area and to meet and host so many wonderful guests. 

My Airbnb hosting journey started when my wife, Jo and I bought Florence Court in Nimmo Street, Middle Park in 2015. It is a heritage listed, mid 30's Art Deco apartment block in where I now offer four fantastic short term accommodation apartments. I now operate sixteen brilliant short to long term accommodation properties in the area ranging from apartments to houses and from one to four bedrooms. They are all stunning and fitted out to the very highest standard. 

As an Airbnb Superhost I offer my guests a concierge like service. I am an unashamed ambassador for the area where I have lived for over 30 years. Just tell me your interests and I will offer my recommendations. 

Each property has a copy of "Adventures" which provides details my recommended local To Do's and the very best of nearby dining pleasures. There are many recommendations for guests of all ages. 

My wife, Jo and I met playing tennis at Kooyong Lawn Tennis Club and were married in Paris just over 28 years ago. Jo is a part time teacher at the local primary school where she is a special education reading teacher. She has a real passion for books, real estate and interior design. A typical week will see her at a local café with friends, walking our dog in the nearby park, seeing a movie, attending her book club, doing a yoga class or shopping for the next thing for one of the properties we fitout and list on Airbnb. 

We have two children, Louis and Natasha. Natasha (Tash) is a Project Co-ordinator in the construction industry. When she is not out socialising or getting away for the weekend, she may occasionally walk our friendly Nova Scotia Duck Tolling Retriever called Hudson. We love pets and welcome them at all properties. 

Our son Louis lives in Portland, Maine, USA where he works for the Boston Celtics basketball team as Player Manager of the G League Maine Celtics.  He attended university in Boston, USA and represented Australia in rowing as a coxswain. 

On weekends, given a chance, Jo and I visit a beach side get-away apartment with stunning sea views in Torquay, just over an hour’s drive from Melbourne. Torquay is Victoria's surf capital and the gateway to the famous Great Ocean Road. The apartment is available for stays on Airbnb. (Sleeps 8). In Torquay, we enjoy walks, great local food, wine, the many surf beaches and the company of friends. 

We have travelled to Europe, the Middle East, Southeast Asia and the USA where we have enjoyed Airbnb hospitality in England, France, Italy, Spain, Bulgaria, Croatia, Turkey, Netherlands, Denmark, Sweden and the United States. I wish to share that same pleasure and the excitement of travel with my guests. 

I am a self-employed Marketing Consultant whose consultancy, Gold Medal Marketing develops and implements winning business development programs for businesses in various industries. I have written and delivered a number of business development programs. 

When not hosting, I am working hard as the honorary Chairman of the Australian Patients Association (APA) which advocates, educates and supports Australian patients. The APA strives to be the voice of and for Australian patients. 

I regularly attend a local gym for regular workouts which I am pleased to introduce to my active guests. 

On weekends in Winter, I watch St. Kilda, an Australian Rules Football Club as a long standing and sadly long-suffering club supporter and member.

With a family of building designers, I am always working on some property development or creative project for myself, family or and friends or for the property owners that I represent. 

I like to catch a movie or show and visit galleries and believing that you should “be a tourist in your own town” try get out and about to something interesting either near or far. 

I look forward to sharing the many great properties which I manage and my local experience with my guests. 

I am always available to ensure that property owners are well served by my services and that guests have a great stay. 

Yours, 

Gary Copolov.

Hi, we are Gus and Feng Feng, and are living as artists raising a young family - Gus is a musician, composer and sound designer who also teaches banjo. Feng Feng is a former dancer with the Chinese Ballet, who has since worked at the Victorian College of the Arts as a choreographer, which is where we met each other when we were both studying there in 2004. In 2018 Feng Feng started studying fashion design at RMIT.

We both love good food (cooking and eating!), good films and good music - Feng Feng also makes jewellry, plus has recently developed quite a skill for knitting and sewing for her kids. Her latest project is designing and making cuff-links to sell at markets, re-using old communist badges from the USSR.  In 2018 she started studying fashion design and technology at RMIT.

We are into the nesting phase of our lives, and spend the bulk of our spare time hanging out as a family with our son Wilfred (12) and Emerald (10), which as you can imagine is a fun time of life for them!  But previously we have both done lots of traveling, around Australia as well as to Europe, Asia and America, and loved using the Airbnb website to find cosy and personal spaces that had privacy and a touch of style. We loved the way it allowed us to tap into a city's culture on a more personal level. Over the summer of 2013/14 we decided to build an extension on to our house so Feng Feng's parents had a place to stay when they visited from China. With the help of award winning architect Chris Stanley from Splinter Society, (a friend who lives locally) we had lots of fun dreaming up and creating what we have now christened the 'Brunswick Basilica'! So it's been built to be enjoyed by special people. Most of the year however it is vacant so we are keen to have visitors come and enjoy it's beautiful design.
We both love living in Brunswick - there's so much interesting stuff going on in the community, lots of venues, cafes, gourmet food trucks, street art, galleries, theatre and shops, it really is the centre of Melbourne's creative heart. We have lots of tips for the adventurous traveler, but can also appreciate that other visitors will be here to work or visit family, so we have designed both places to be homey, private and a little bit special. 

We'd love you to come and stay with us, do come and visit!

host_about:

I love the arts, the outdoors, animals and languages - I speak reasonably good French, German and Spanish. 

5 of the things I can't live without: a  great friends, good food, dogs, the arts and the outdoors. And to cheat and add a sixth, I love antique china and other collectables and love to scour flea markets for treasures! Some of my recent favourite movies include Monsieur Lazhar, the King's Speech, Bill Cunningham - a documentary (about the New York Times photographer). My taste in music is pretty eclectic and ranges from world music to classical and folk. 

I have enjoyed using Airbnb accommodation on my travels - so much more interesting than staying in hotels, and am now opening up my own house to travellers as a host.  As a guest I treat Airbnb accommodation as I would my own home, leaving it as I find it with due respect and consideration for my host or hosts. 

I am excited about the people I will meet, the conversations we will have and the stories we will share. My aim is to give you a comfortable and relaxed base on your travels where you can enjoy some home comforts  - even cuddles with my dog, Bertie. And I can help your plan your stay in Melbourne to get the most out of it. 

My life motto is a quote from Oscar Wilde: Be yourself, everyone else is already taken..

host_about:
With my husband Bill Molyneux, I share a passion for Australia's precious environment and wildlife, and we devote our lives to their protection and conservation.  Botanical research, wildlife rescue & conservation, outback bush travel, and Airedale Rescue work, together with running our B&B, still enables us to cherish the special moments of each day when the wildlife of Wombat Bend and the light across the billabong capture and hold our attention, and we become part of the landscape that we have created.  We welcome all who share such a vision.  I'd say our life philosophy is that everyone can make a difference ~ for the better.

It doesn't get any nicer than that, does it?

host_about:
YOUR HOST: GARY COPOLOV 

Hello, my name is Gary and I live in Middle Park, Melbourne.

I currently manage over twenty inner bay side short to long term accommodation properties located in Middle Park, Albert Park, South Melbourne, Port Melbourne, St.Kilda, Balaclava, Elwood and even one property in North Carlton and Torquay.

Those in the "hood" know that these locations are arguably some of Melbourne’s best and most desirable inner-city suburbs. I believe I am fortunate to live and manage properties in the area and to meet and host so many wonderful guests. 

My Airbnb hosting journey started when my wife, Jo and I bought Florence Court in Nimmo Street, Middle Park in 2015. It is a heritage listed, mid 30's Art Deco apartment block in where I now offer four fantastic short term accommodation apartments. I now operate sixteen brilliant short to long term accommodation properties in the area ranging from apartments to houses and from one to four bedrooms. They are all stunning and fitted out to the very highest standard. 

As an Airbnb Superhost I offer my guests a concierge like service. I am an unashamed ambassador for the area where I have lived for over 30 years. Just tell me your interests and I will offer my recommendations. 

Each property has a copy of "Adventures" which provides details my recommended local To Do's and the very best of nearby dining pleasures. There are many recommendations for guests of all ages. 

My wife, Jo and I met playing tennis at Kooyong Lawn Tennis Club and were married in Paris just over 28 years ago. Jo is a part time teacher at the local primary school where she is a special education reading teacher. She has a real passion for books, real estate and interior design. A typical week will see her at a local café with friends, walking our dog in the nearby park, seeing a movie, attending her book club, doing a yoga class or shopping for the next thing for one of the properties we fitout and list on Airbnb. 

We have two children, Louis and Natasha. Natasha (Tash) is a Project Co-ordinator in the construction industry. When she is not out socialising or getting away for the weekend, she may occasionally walk our friendly Nova Scotia Duck Tolling Retriever called Hudson. We love pets and welcome them at all properties. 

Our son Louis lives in Portland, Maine, USA where he works for the Boston Celtics basketball team as Player Manager of the G League Maine Celtics.  He attended university in Boston, USA and represented Australia in rowing as a coxswain. 

On weekends, given a chance, Jo and I visit a beach side get-away apartment with stunning sea views in Torquay, just over an hour’s drive from Melbourne. Torquay is Victoria's surf capital and the gateway to the famous Great Ocean Road. The apartment is available for stays on Airbnb. (Sleeps 8). In Torquay, we enjoy walks, great local food, wine, the many surf beaches and the company of friends. 

We have travelled to Europe, the Middle East, Southeast Asia and the USA where we have enjoyed Airbnb hospitality in England, France, Italy, Spain, Bulgaria, Croatia, Turkey, Netherlands, Denmark, Sweden and the United States. I wish to share that same pleasure and the excitement of travel with my guests. 

I am a self-employed Marketing Consultant whose consultancy, Gold Medal Marketing develops and implements winning business development programs for businesses in various industries. I have written and delivered a number of business development programs. 

When not hosting, I am working hard as the honorary Chairman of the Australian Patients Association (APA) which advocates, educates and supports Australian patients. The APA strives to be the voice of and for Australian patients. 

I regularly attend a local gym for regular workouts which I am pleased to introduce to my active guests. 

On weekends in Winter, I watch St. Kilda, an Australian Rules Football Club as a long standing and sadly long-suffering club supporter and member.

With a family of building designers, I am always working on some property development or creative project for myself, family or and friends or for the property owners that I represent. 

I like to catch a movie or show and visit galleries and believing that you should “be a tourist in your own town” try get out and about to something interesting either near or far. 

I look forward to sharing the many great properties which I manage and my local experience with my guests. 

I am always available to ensure that property owners are well served by my services and that guests have a great stay. 

Yours, 

Gary Copolov.

neighborhood_overview:
The beautiful Dandenong Ranges, 45 kms east of Melbourne CBD, are at the tail end of the Great Dividing Range that runs down the east coast of Australia. Scattered throughout the Dandenong Ranges are several picturesque villages. Olinda (where we are) is one of the prettiest, with Sassafras & Kallista a few minutes drive away. Enjoy lovely cafes, restaurants, antique & vintage shops, galleries, clothing boutiques & speciality shops (and a couple of pubs 2 mins drive or 10 mins walk away).
Lovers of fresh air, soaring Mountain Ash trees, fern gullies, parks, gardens, bush walks, plant nurseries & National Parks will be spoilt for choice. Only 3 minutes walk away from Campania are the famous National Rhododendron Gardens - 10 acres of beauty & peace, free to enter. Just a short drive to William Ricketts Sanctuary, Alfred Nichols Gardens, Burnham Beeches (plus the Piggery owned by chef Shannon Bennett), Sherbrooke Forest, Mt Dandenong Observatory & Sky High, the Arboretum and the Dan
host_about: My husband Ken & I are almost-retired and live 6-7 months of the year in Olinda in the beautiful Dandenong Ranges, east of Melbourne in Victoria Australia. The other 5-6 months we live in our house in Cabrerets, in the Lot region, SW France (also on Airbnb). In Olinda we share a lovely property with my sister Barbara and enjoy our 1.3 acre garden with our cat Tipsy. We often welcome travellers from Help Exchange, both to assist with the gardening at Campania but also to spend time with interesting people from around the world. We love to travel and enjoy staying in less discovered parts of the world, but especially love France. Our favourite activities include spending time with our 3 sons and their families, wining & dining, cooking, gardening, walking, biking, canoeing...I also enjoy fishing but Ken prefers eating rather than catching fish! My favourite activity in France is searching for vintage wares, which has now become a hobby-business: (Hidden by Airbnb) @afrenchaffaire  Such fun! We rent our 3-bedroom house in France to others from time to time and also offer accommodation in our apartment @ Campania, in Olinda.

Rob

We hope to facilitate a wonderful experience for people staying in our property, just as others have done for us when we have been overseas. We always aim to meet our guests on arrival and to relate to people in a respectful and friendly way.

Our travel experiences in the last 10 years have included all states in Australia, Europe, UK, South Africa, Canada and Alaska. Many years ago before having a family we also travelled around China and South East Asia and would love to revisit these regions. In our travels we have been most captivated by fabulous scenery and by the amazing people we have met, whether it be fellow travellers or lovely locals who we have connected with. 

Peter has been an electrician for more than 40 years and has a great passion for Australian Rules football and playing golf with good friends. Marianne is a psychologist and loves to read, catch up with friends over a coffee and take our dogs for long walks. Occasionally our daughter Jess will help you check in, she is working on a PhD and likes to take her eyes off a computer screen and help out when she can.

Melbourne is a wonderful city to visit, as it offers so much in cultural, sporting and dining experiences to discover. We’d be happy offer suggestions to help you to explore your interests while in Melbourne.

We have been hosts on Airbnb for several years and have hosted friends and family for many more years, providing a warm, welcoming and relaxing experience. We welcome your inquiries about staying in Melbourne.

We look forward to meeting you.

Peter and Marianne

We are a nurse (Angus) and a Human Resource professional (Lana) and we LOVE to travel, spend time with friends, cycle, crochet and read. Although Angus wanted to make sure that it's me that likes crocheting! 

The five things I can't live without are: chocolate, coffee, animals (specifically my sausage dog Coco and our giant cat called Ted), friends and family!

AS A TRAVELLER(Lana)
In 2013 I went to France, Italy, Serbia, Croatia and Vietnam with a friend where we backpacked and AirBnB'd around, went to a music festival and hired a car to drive around.
In 2014 I went to New York on my own for a couple of weeks for a music festival, stayed at a hostel.
In 2015, I took my parents on a 5 week European extravaganza through France, Italy and Greece. We hired a car and took our time meandering through and staying exclusively w AirBnB. 
In 2016, I think I stayed in Australia, but... I met Angus!
2017 was action packed, we went to NZ to be the 'best lady' army friends wedding. 
In 2017 I went to Italy, Montenegro and Serbia for my 35th birthday celebrations. I travelled with my two friends and Angus. Staying at AirBnB places of course! 

Style: I treat others as I like to be treated, and that includes belongings and their properties. I am respectful and if I'm going to be partying, it will be outside! I am an extroverted, social person who loves getting out and about.

AS A HOST
I joined AirBnB as a host in July 2015 when I was travelling around and not at home for lengthy periods. So I put up my one bedroom apartment up on Airbnb which gave me a piece of mind to ensure that someone will be in there and I absolutely love my apartment and want everyone else to as well!

Since then, in early 2019 we bought our townhouse in Abbotsford. It needed some TLC so we spent a few months (read: every spare waking moment) renovating on our home ready for us to move in. However we're house sitting until November in Moonee Ponds which is about 8km from our new home.

We have spent a lot of time renovating it but you will find me constantly shuffling things around. I am definitely a home body when I'm at home and love being surrounded by pretty, tidy clean areas. 

I like to think about what things are important to me when I am looking at places on AirBnB and make sure I have those ready!

Favourite Destination: Italy 
Book: The Girl with all the Gifts, The Time Traveller's Wife
Movies: Some Like it Hot, Ace Ventura, Crazy Stupid Love
Music: Anything I can dance to!
Food: Anything sweet, or salty, or crunchy, or sour.... okay, everything!

Motto: it is what it is.

host_about:
Having lived between Melbourne, Paris and New York in the last decade, you could say I'm a bit of a global citizen with a penchant for city living.

My interests include art (political street art, especially), music (turn up the soul, funk & conscious hip hop), languages (je peux parler français), travel (unfamiliar places like Mexico & Vietnam), the politics of social justice, and philosophy (I'm forever fascinated by human behaviour).

Currently reading: Ta-Nehisi Coates, 'Between The World And Me'
Currently listening: Melbourne's own, Hiatus Kaiyote
Favourite film: Mathieu Kassovitz, 'La Haine'
Favourite food: Pho

As far as sharing a space is concerned, I'm a considerate, laid back host and a friendly, respectful guest.

Tempting as it is to draw on Camus, Mandela or Angelou, my life motto is borrowed from the tenets of hip hop philosophy: KEEP IT REAL.

host_about:
YOUR HOST: GARY COPOLOV 

Hello, my name is Gary and I live in Middle Park, Melbourne.

I currently manage over twenty inner bay side short to long term accommodation properties located in Middle Park, Albert Park, South Melbourne, Port Melbourne, St.Kilda, Balaclava, Elwood and even one property in North Carlton and Torquay.

Those in the "hood" know that these locations are arguably some of Melbourne’s best and most desirable inner-city suburbs. I believe I am fortunate to live and manage properties in the area and to meet and host so many wonderful guests. 

My Airbnb hosting journey started when my wife, Jo and I bought Florence Court in Nimmo Street, Middle Park in 2015. It is a heritage listed, mid 30's Art Deco apartment block in where I now offer four fantastic short term accommodation apartments. I now operate sixteen brilliant short to long term accommodation properties in the area ranging from apartments to houses and from one to four bedrooms. They are all stunning and fitted out to the very highest standard. 

As an Airbnb Superhost I offer my guests a concierge like service. I am an unashamed ambassador for the area where I have lived for over 30 years. Just tell me your interests and I will offer my recommendations. 

Each property has a copy of "Adventures" which provides details my recommended local To Do's and the very best of nearby dining pleasures. There are many recommendations for guests of all ages. 

My wife, Jo and I met playing tennis at Kooyong Lawn Tennis Club and were married in Paris just over 28 years ago. Jo is a part time teacher at the local primary school where she is a special education reading teacher. She has a real passion for books, real estate and interior design. A typical week will see her at a local café with friends, walking our dog in the nearby park, seeing a movie, attending her book club, doing a yoga class or shopping for the next thing for one of the properties we fitout and list on Airbnb. 

We have two children, Louis and Natasha. Natasha (Tash) is a Project Co-ordinator in the construction industry. When she is not out socialising or getting away for the weekend, she may occasionally walk our friendly Nova Scotia Duck Tolling Retriever called Hudson. We love pets and welcome them at all properties. 

Our son Louis lives in Portland, Maine, USA where he works for the Boston Celtics basketball team as Player Manager of the G League Maine Celtics.  He attended university in Boston, USA and represented Australia in rowing as a coxswain. 

On weekends, given a chance, Jo and I visit a beach side get-away apartment with stunning sea views in Torquay, just over an hour’s drive from Melbourne. Torquay is Victoria's surf capital and the gateway to the famous Great Ocean Road. The apartment is available for stays on Airbnb. (Sleeps 8). In Torquay, we enjoy walks, great local food, wine, the many surf beaches and the company of friends. 

We have travelled to Europe, the Middle East, Southeast Asia and the USA where we have enjoyed Airbnb hospitality in England, France, Italy, Spain, Bulgaria, Croatia, Turkey, Netherlands, Denmark, Sweden and the United States. I wish to share that same pleasure and the excitement of travel with my guests. 

I am a self-employed Marketing Consultant whose consultancy, Gold Medal Marketing develops and implements winning business development programs for businesses in various industries. I have written and delivered a number of business development programs. 

When not hosting, I am working hard as the honorary Chairman of the Australian Patients Association (APA) which advocates, educates and supports Australian patients. The APA strives to be the voice of and for Australian patients.

host_about:
YOUR HOST: GARY COPOLOV 

Hello, my name is Gary and I live in Middle Park, Melbourne.

I currently manage over twenty inner bay side short to long term accommodation properties located in Middle Park, Albert Park, South Melbourne, Port Melbourne, St.Kilda, Balaclava, Elwood and even one property in North Carlton and Torquay.

Those in the "hood" know that these locations are arguably some of Melbourne’s best and most desirable inner-city suburbs. I believe I am fortunate to live and manage properties in the area and to meet and host so many wonderful guests. 

My Airbnb hosting journey started when my wife, Jo and I bought Florence Court in Nimmo Street, Middle Park in 2015. It is a heritage listed, mid 30's Art Deco apartment block in where I now offer four fantastic short term accommodation apartments. I now operate sixteen brilliant short to long term accommodation properties in the area ranging from apartments to houses and from one to four bedrooms. They are all stunning and fitted out to the very highest standard. 

As an Airbnb Superhost I offer my guests a concierge like service. I am an unashamed ambassador for the area where I have lived for over 30 years. Just tell me your interests and I will offer my recommendations. 

Each property has a copy of "Adventures" which provides details my recommended local To Do's and the very best of nearby dining pleasures. There are many recommendations for guests of all ages. 

My wife, Jo and I met playing tennis at Kooyong Lawn Tennis Club and were married in Paris just over 28 years ago. Jo is a part time teacher at the local primary school where she is a special education reading teacher. She has a real passion for books, real estate and interior design. A typical week will see her at a local café with friends, walking our dog in the nearby park, seeing a movie, attending her book club, doing a yoga class or shopping for the next thing for one of the properties we fitout and list on Airbnb. 

We have two children, Louis and Natasha. Natasha (Tash) is a Project Co-ordinator in the construction industry. When she is not out socialising or getting away for the weekend, she may occasionally walk our friendly Nova Scotia Duck Tolling Retriever called Hudson. We love pets and welcome them at all properties. 

Our son Louis lives in Portland, Maine, USA where he works for the Boston Celtics basketball team as Player Manager of the G League Maine Celtics.  He attended university in Boston, USA and represented Australia in rowing as a coxswain. 

On weekends, given a chance, Jo and I visit a beach side get-away apartment with stunning sea views in Torquay, just over an hour’s drive from Melbourne. Torquay is Victoria's surf capital and the gateway to the famous Great Ocean Road. The apartment is available for stays on Airbnb. (Sleeps 8). In Torquay, we enjoy walks, great local food, wine, the many surf beaches and the company of friends. 

We have travelled to Europe, the Middle East, Southeast Asia and the USA where we have enjoyed Airbnb hospitality in England, France, Italy, Spain, Bulgaria, Croatia, Turkey, Netherlands, Denmark, Sweden and the United States. I wish to share that same pleasure and the excitement of travel with my guests. 

I am a self-employed Marketing Consultant whose consultancy, Gold Medal Marketing develops and implements winning business development programs for businesses in various industries. I have written and delivered a number of business development programs. 

When not hosting, I am working hard as the honorary Chairman of the Australian Patients Association (APA) which advocates, educates and supports Australian patients. The APA strives to be the voice of and for Australian patients. 

I regularly attend a local gym for regular workouts which I am pleased to introduce to my active guests. 

On weekends in Winter, I watch St. Kilda, an Australian Rules Football Club as a long standing and sadly long-suffering club supporter and member.

With a family of building designers, I am always working on some property development or creative project for myself, family or and friends or for the property owners that I represent. 

I like to catch a movie or show and visit galleries and believing that you should “be a tourist in your own town” try get out and about to something interesting either near or far. 

I look forward to sharing the many great properties which I manage and my local experience with my guests. 

I am always available to ensure that property owners are well served by my services and that guests have a great stay. 

Yours, 

Gary Copolov.

Rob

host_about:

Back home and back to reality, I work part time for a women's health organisation promoting gender equity and preventing violence against women. I'm a solo mum to my 12yo who attends Steiner Primary School and very much looking forward to high school!

I have owned my little house in Warburton for 16 years. Most of this time was with some friends, but now just on my own. I was born in Warburton and spent most of my childhood there so it is a special place. I love that I can still come back here and definitely feel like a local when I do. host_about:
YOUR HOST: GARY COPOLOV 

Hello, my name is Gary and I live in Middle Park, Melbourne.

I currently manage over twenty inner bay side short to long term accommodation properties located in Middle Park, Albert Park, South Melbourne, Port Melbourne, St.Kilda, Balaclava, Elwood and even one property in North Carlton and Torquay.

Those in the "hood" know that these locations are arguably some of Melbourne’s best and most desirable inner-city suburbs. I believe I am fortunate to live and manage properties in the area and to meet and host so many wonderful guests. 

My Airbnb hosting journey started when my wife, Jo and I bought Florence Court in Nimmo Street, Middle Park in 2015. It is a heritage listed, mid 30's Art Deco apartment block in where I now offer four fantastic short term accommodation apartments. I now operate sixteen brilliant short to long term accommodation properties in the area ranging from apartments to houses and from one to four bedrooms. They are all stunning and fitted out to the very highest standard. 

As an Airbnb Superhost I offer my guests a concierge like service. I am an unashamed ambassador for the area where I have lived for over 30 years. Just tell me your interests and I will offer my recommendations. 

Each property has a copy of "Adventures" which provides details my recommended local To Do's and the very best of nearby dining pleasures. There are many recommendations for guests of all ages. 

My wife, Jo and I met playing tennis at Kooyong Lawn Tennis Club and were married in Paris just over 28 years ago. Jo is a part time teacher at the local primary school where she is a special education reading teacher. She has a real passion for books, real estate and interior design. A typical week will see her at a local café with friends, walking our dog in the nearby park, seeing a movie, attending her book club, doing a yoga class or shopping for the next thing for one of the properties we fitout and list on Airbnb. 

We have two children, Louis and Natasha. Natasha (Tash) is a Project Co-ordinator in the construction industry. When she is not out socialising or getting away for the weekend, she may occasionally walk our friendly Nova Scotia Duck Tolling Retriever called Hudson. We love pets and welcome them at all properties. 

Our son Louis lives in Portland, Maine, USA where he works for the Boston Celtics basketball team as Player Manager of the G League Maine Celtics.  He attended university in Boston, USA and represented Australia in rowing as a coxswain. 

On weekends, given a chance, Jo and I visit a beach side get-away apartment with stunning sea views in Torquay, just over an hour’s drive from Melbourne. Torquay is Victoria's surf capital and the gateway to the famous Great Ocean Road. The apartment is available for stays on Airbnb. (Sleeps 8). In Torquay, we enjoy walks, great local food, wine, the many surf beaches and the company of friends. 

We have travelled to Europe, the Middle East, Southeast Asia and the USA where we have enjoyed Airbnb hospitality in England, France, Italy, Spain, Bulgaria, Croatia, Turkey, Netherlands, Denmark, Sweden and the United States. I wish to share that same pleasure and the excitement of travel with my guests. 

I am a self-employed Marketing Consultant whose consultancy, Gold Medal Marketing develops and implements winning business development programs for businesses in various industries. I have written and delivered a number of business development programs. 

When not hosting, I am working hard as the honorary Chairman of the Australian Patients Association (APA) which advocates, educates and supports Australian patients. The APA strives to be the voice of and for Australian patients. 

I regularly attend a local gym for regular workouts which I am pleased to introduce to my active guests. 

On weekends in Winter, I watch St. Kilda, an Australian Rules Football Club as a long standing and sadly long-suffering club supporter and member.

With a family of building designers, I am always working on some property development or creative project for myself, family or and friends or for the property owners that I represent. 

I like to catch a movie or show and visit galleries and believing that you should “be a tourist in your own town” try get out and about to something interesting either near or far. 

I look forward to sharing the many great properties which I manage and my local experience with my guests. 

I am always available to ensure that property owners are well served by my services and that guests have a great stay. 

Yours, 

Gary Copolov.

host_about:
My family and I have been hosting guests and friends at our property(s) for over 20 years now .  We love providing a warm and welcoming home in the wonderful city of Melbourne. The innovators of the Smallfootprint brand - we design and build smallfootprint zero energy homes .  Our philosophy of treading lightly follows through to our homes , with smaller spaces , but comfortable and high quality fittings.  Our smallfootprint brand supports our climate , our planet and our communities .   Throughout our homes you will find smallfootprint brands -  honey from our bees,  fragrances ,  wooden boards ,  journals ,  coasters -  and soon our own branded wine,  knife sets, desks and many other products .   I love to travel all around the world with my family, Europe, America, South east Asia and the Pacific Islands.  We love going to the islands , where only our footprints are left in the sand , and we can find inspiration from the more simple life of the islanders .  We bring this inspiration back to our smallfootprint brands and homes - to declutter, simplify and enjoy the here and now .  

I love the sun , the simple life , barefoot, the  bluest of oceans,   the sound of waves , sunsets and balmy evenings -  - my plan is to visit every island in this beautiful world before I die, a mission I am determined to fulfil- with only ever our footprints left behind .

When you sail the oceans of the world - or ski mountains throughout the world you do discover beauty and a fragility that needs us to protect it .

I have been preparing, presenting and hosting properties for guests for most of my life and have even had them used by Grand Mecure and the Sebel chain. 
  And now under the Smallfootprint Brand we bring you the simple, beautiful life , the fragrance , the stillness and the tranquility of NOW - all encompassed in our Smallfootprint homes .
Come and experience the very first in the world - the Smallfootprint homes in Footscray , one of the coolest cities in Melbourne - zero energy homes - so important in today’s world .   This is the evolution of urban renewal in Melbourne ...... and then .......   watch this space -  Smallfootprint homes and products that reflect our need for simplicity and comfort . Always remember to tread lightly ,  help our movement grow and let’s look after our planet earth - remembering healthy planets are hard to find . 

Hoping we can welcome you soon .

host_about:
YOUR HOST: GARY COPOLOV 

Hello, my name is Gary and I live in Middle Park, Melbourne.

I currently manage over twenty inner bay side short to long term accommodation properties located in Middle Park, Albert Park, South Melbourne, Port Melbourne, St.Kilda, Balaclava, Elwood and even one property in North Carlton and Torquay.

Those in the "hood" know that these locations are arguably some of Melbourne’s best and most desirable inner-city suburbs. I believe I am fortunate to live and manage properties in the area and to meet and host so many wonderful guests. 

My Airbnb hosting journey started when my wife, Jo and I bought Florence Court in Nimmo Street, Middle Park in 2015. It is a heritage listed, mid 30's Art Deco apartment block in where I now offer four fantastic short term accommodation apartments. I now operate sixteen brilliant short to long term accommodation properties in the area ranging from apartments to houses and from one to four bedrooms. They are all stunning and fitted out to the very highest standard. 

As an Airbnb Superhost I offer my guests a concierge like service. I am an unashamed ambassador for the area where I have lived for over 30 years. Just tell me your interests and I will offer my recommendations. 

Each property has a copy of "Adventures" which provides details my recommended local To Do's and the very best of nearby dining pleasures. There are many recommendations for guests of all ages. 

My wife, Jo and I met playing tennis at Kooyong Lawn Tennis Club and were married in Paris just over 28 years ago. Jo is a part time teacher at the local primary school where she is a special education reading teacher. She has a real passion for books, real estate and interior design. A typical week will see her at a local café with friends, walking our dog in the nearby park, seeing a movie, attending her book club, doing a yoga class or shopping for the next thing for one of the properties we fitout and list on Airbnb. 

We have two children, Louis and Natasha. Natasha (Tash) is a Project Co-ordinator in the construction industry. When she is not out socialising or getting away for the weekend, she may occasionally walk our friendly Nova Scotia Duck Tolling Retriever called Hudson. We love pets and welcome them at all properties. 

Our son Louis lives in Portland, Maine, USA where he works for the Boston Celtics basketball team as Player Manager of the G League Maine Celtics.  He attended university in Boston, USA and represented Australia in rowing as a coxswain. 

On weekends, given a chance, Jo and I visit a beach side get-away apartment with stunning sea views in Torquay, just over an hour’s drive from Melbourne. Torquay is Victoria's surf capital and the gateway to the famous Great Ocean Road. The apartment is available for stays on Airbnb. (Sleeps 8). In Torquay, we enjoy walks, great local food, wine, the many surf beaches and the company of friends. 

We have travelled to Europe, the Middle East, Southeast Asia and the USA where we have enjoyed Airbnb hospitality in England, France, Italy, Spain, Bulgaria, Croatia, Turkey, Netherlands, Denmark, Sweden and the United States. I wish to share that same pleasure and the excitement of travel with my guests. 

I am a self-employed Marketing Consultant whose consultancy, Gold Medal Marketing develops and implements winning business development programs for businesses in various industries. I have written and delivered a number of business development programs. 

When not hosting, I am working hard as the honorary Chairman of the Australian Patients Association (APA) which advocates, educates and supports Australian patients. The APA strives to be the voice of and for Australian patients. 

I regularly attend a local gym for regular workouts which I am pleased to introduce to my active guests. 

On weekends in Winter, I watch St. Kilda, an Australian Rules Football Club as a long standing and sadly long-suffering club supporter and member.

With a family of building designers, I am always working on some property development or creative project for myself, family or and friends or for the property owners that I represent. 

I like to catch a movie or show and visit galleries and believing that you should “be a tourist in your own town” try get out and about to something interesting either near or far. 

I look forward to sharing the many great properties which I manage and my local experience with my guests. 

I am always available to ensure that property owners are well served by my services and that guests have a great stay. 

Yours, 

Gary Copolov.

At the moment I have been reading books about 10 - 12th century history of the Languedoc area in France. Prior to that I have been reading books related to the Wars of the roses. Also love to read papers, cook books and where would we be without the occasional trashy novel - particularly on a plane to the next travel experience.

Did someone mention food and wine - well count me in. Particularly Asian fusion - blame this on my Asian travels and the Asian influence on a lot of the cuisine where I love. Melbourne is truly a foodie destination - so we are always spoiled for choice.

Another great thing about Melbourne is that it is also the cultural capital of Australia. I love live entertainment and would go to something "live" at least 4 a 5 times a month - plays, opera, ballet, cabaret and concerts. Also add to the mix going to see movies. I'm a semi retired former co-owner of a video production company and until further notice, fit, sane and without significant personality disorders.  To date I've travelled mostly in Asia and particularly in Thailand but I have a son and daughter who work in Cambodia, which I visit from time to time as well.   Most recently though, I've spent some time in Europe.  Travel is in my blood and so long as I can keep putting one foot in front of the other, I'll keep it up.  
I've sampled all sorts of accommodation but prefer light and airy places with a bit of room, some temperature control, Wi Fi connection, a bit of outside space and proximity to public transport.  
With few exceptions, whatever it happens to be, I love places with a vibrant culture, especially when it's there to be enjoyed on the street.  I also like being close to water, particularly when it's lapping up on a beach and I'm a big fan of locations with their own distinctive food - and where grapevines flourish - wine as well.  
Books?  All sorts but I particularly like biographies, engrossingly well written novels and histories and descriptions of places I've never been to and may never visit.  Movies? once or twice a week, the most recent one that really impressed was 'Three Billboards...'. 
As a guest who's also a home owner, I treat my host's house or apartment as if it were my own, so I keep it clean and tidy and respect the furniture and fittings: as a host, I expect the same from my guests. Aside from that I'm pretty easy going and like meeting people from all walks of life and hearing about whatever aspects of their lives they choose to share with me.

Yarra Bend Park is BIG! 260hectares with 12kms of the Yarra River winding through it. Great for running, cycling, rowing, kayaking & walking. There are many walking tracks to help you explore this vast and varied park. Stop for refreshments at Studley Park Boathouse or Fairfield Boathouse.
Darebin Creek walks are also a highlight of the area - you won’t believe we are just 7kms from the CBD!
Kissaten Cafe is closest (50metres). It serves tasty Japanese inspired food and drinks. Hoppa & Joe Cafe and Arthur Street Food Store is 500metres away.
The bus to Fairfield Boathouse, Carlton, Melbourne University, quirky Fitzroy & Queen Victoria Market is 50metres from the house.
It is 7 mins walk to Fairfield Station & train service to Melbourne CBD.
Station Street has busy food shopping, with three small supermarkets & many restaurants. It is 8 mins walk from our house.
Our street is a friendly suburban street with wonderful neighbours.
Fairfield Boathouse

I originally came from UK, but have been living in Oz since I was 9 years old.  My fave cities are Paris, Berlin and New York, but Hanoi has now added to that list!!! host_about:
Hey there you curious creatures! Time to share a little about ourselves. Mike was born and raised in New Zealand and I have a Greek background but am from a small country town in Victoria. Would you believe that in all the time we’ve been together, I haven’t been able to convince Mike to do the HAKA for me? And if you're wondering, the answer is yes...he’s an ex-rugby player and All Blacks man.

Mike trained as a chef and moved to the UK in his early 20’s to work and travel through Europe. He is a Sensei, 1st Dan black belt and passionate about teaching children the art of Karate. Mike is also a qualified landscaper, is now heavily involved in property and is one of those people who’s annoyingly good at everything.

I graduated and practiced as a Podiatrist for a couple of years, before moving into the advertising industry, security risk management and recently a furniture design & importing business. We launched our hosting journey as a way to help others create unforgettable experiences during their travels whilst having the freedom to personally explore more of our amazing world at the same time!

We’re both fans of entrepreneurship, love Gary Vaynerchuck (if you’ve never heard of him, do yourself a favour and look him up) and enjoy studying personal development, online business, the sharing economy and anything that piques our interest at the time. Podcasts, Kindle, books, online courses...we love learning new things.

Thanks for stopping by. We hope the read was worth it and so look forward connecting with you as hosts or as travellers. We will do our best to make your stay truly memorable in all the right ways and also can’t wait to be great guests if we happen to chance by your Airbnb in your little corner of the globe. 

One more thought to take with you wherever you may be...

We Travel Not To Escape Life, But For Life Not To Escape Us.

See you very soon!


Mike & Panagiota x

Close to 7 Acre rock with its incredible views, as well as Bunyip State Park and the Ada tree.
The town has a pub, with a few basic supplies.

There is a large supermarket open 7 days 15 minutes drive away in Yarra Junction or an organic grocery store open 6 days a week called Village Greens, not open Sundays.
Yarra Junction also has a laundromat if needed, Indian food, chemist, library, recreation centre and cafes.
A beautiful cafe called Nancy’s of the Valley is located in Yarra Junction that serves delicious drinks and food.

On Fridays from 3:30pm there is a market, called ECOS, in Milgrove about a 17 minute drive.
And an organic food market in Healesville Saturday mornings.

name: Lovely spacious Victorian house, walk to the city
description:
Lovely large 100 year old Italianate Victorian in South Yarra. Two blocks from a tram to just about anywhere, walk to the city in twenty minutes. A dozen restaurants within five minutes walk.

Permit available for 24 hour on-street parking for one car.

Three double bedrooms, all with ensuites, plus guest loo.

The space
The most common feedback from guests is that the house is so comfortable they tend to stay home rather than go out.

Study is good for reading and it has a piano, the sitting room is perfect for relaxing, chatting and watching television and the formal dining room is lovely to sit around in the late afternoon when the sun shines in. Good for games at night too.

The conservatory is really pleasant and light from early morning til the sun goes down but also good at night for dinners. It looks out on the back garden.

Other things to note
Please note pets are not allowed. Sorry Scamp.
neighborhood_overview:
The house is in a fabulous spot for exploring Melbourne.

Great coffee five minutes’ walk away in Domain Road. While you’re there buy the best sourdough in Melbourne at D. Chirico bakery.

There are three quick eats places in the next block - McDonald’s, Subway and Gentleman George burgers and beer.

Chemist, newsagent and post office are all in the arcade a block further on from McDonald’s. There is an excellent wine shop there too. It’s open late and stocks some very interesting and unusual wines. Also plenty of good champagne.

Trams to the city, Toorak and pretty much all Melbourne are at the St Kilda Road Terminus. Follow your nose from McDonald’s, the terminus is new, works smoothly and all instructions are clear. Pretty sure you can buy a tram card at the newsagent.

If you are looking for an upmarket dinner try France Soir, Toorak Road near Punt Road. Fabulous food, all The Rolling Stones (except Mick, who left early)

Sunbury has many historic bluestone bridges, railway viaducts and churches. The area is home to Emu Bottom Homestead (c. 1835), Victoria’s oldest homestead; the bluestone cellar doors of Goona Warra Vineyard (c. 1858) and Craiglee (c. 1866). Aitken’s Gap Gaol

host_about:
Hi from Bronnie and Neil ;-)
We love being airbnb hosts and sharing our homes and our beautiful city with others.
We have been airbnb hosts since 2013 and during that time we have met thousands of amazing and wonderful people from all around the world and Australia.
We offer a range of properties, from high end luxury to family friendly. We also love to share our large and comfortable Guest House (Rosebank) in Healesville.

We like to think we offer all of that and more! All our are properties are professionally cleaned and we use hotel quality, commercially laundered linen on our comfortable beds.  We try to meet all our guests on arrival to say hello and are on hand to offer help, advice and inside tips of places to go and things to see.

(You can view our properties by clicking the View Full Profile link below and clicking on the listings on the left hand side of the page). 

On a personal note, we're pretty easy going, and love getting out and about exploring different places. We are both keen travellers and have done our fair share of it in Australia and overseas - whether backpacking, camping, or an occasional splurge on 5-star resorts! You wouldn't call us 'party animals', but we do like socialising and meeting people.  We enjoy a wide variety of interests, love the movies, eating out, popping down to the beach or river, and enjoying the many exciting sporting events and festivals that Melbourne and regional Victoria has to offer.
Our motto is "strangers are friends you haven't met yet!"
Wishing you happy travels and looking forward to meeting you soon :-)

Best regards
Bronnie and Neil

host_about:
Hi from Bronnie and Neil ;-)
We love being airbnb hosts and sharing our homes and our beautiful city with others.
We have been airbnb hosts since 2013 and during that time we have met thousands of amazing and wonderful people from all around the world and Australia.
We offer a range of properties, from high end luxury to family friendly. We also love to share our large and comfortable Guest House (Rosebank) in Healesville. 
We use airbnb ourselves when we travel and know that people are looking for - great locations at a good price, that are clean, comfortable and friendly! We like to think we offer all of that and more! All our are properties are professionally cleaned and we use hotel quality, commercially laundered linen on our comfortable beds.  We try to meet all our guests on arrival to say hello and are on hand to offer help, advice and inside tips of places to go and things to see. 
Most of our properties include free parking which is a real bonus in the city and Foxtel (cable) television and other homely touches so you 'can live like a local'. (You can view our properties by clicking the View Full Profile link below and clicking on the listings on the left hand side of the page). 

On a personal note, we're pretty easy going, and love getting out and about exploring different places. We are both keen travellers and have done our fair share of it in Australia and overseas - whether backpacking, camping, or an occasional splurge on 5-star resorts! You wouldn't call us 'party animals', but we do like socialising and meeting people.  We enjoy a wide variety of interests, love the movies, eating out, popping down to the beach or river, and enjoying the many exciting sporting events and festivals that Melbourne and regional Victoria has to offer.
Our motto is "strangers are friends you haven't met yet!"
Wishing you happy travels and looking forward to meeting you soon :-)

Best regards
Bronnie and Neil

I started StayCentral Melbourne Corporate Apartments with one apartment, and now manage multiple properties in many different locations in inner Melbourne.

Like many of my guests, I love to travel; both overseas to places like the Mulu Caves in Borneo, ancient cities (in many old countries), Antarctica & Alaska, Patagonia, and colourful markets in amazing places like Pha Long in Vietnam, Jaisalmer in India, Tozeur in Tunisia & La Paz in Bolivia. The restaurants and cafes in Melbourne are amongst the best in the world. description:
Little Yarra Tiny House is situated on a picturesque 30 acre organic farm in the Yarra Valley. With sweeping views of the farm, guests can have a swim in the nearby Little Yarra River, or simple enjoy the farm from the large deck.

The space
Little Yarra Tiny House has been built with sustainability in mind and endeavours to tread lightly with a composting toilet (award winning ‘Ecoflow’ composting toilet) and 100% rainwater usage. Access is via a seperate driveway and the dwelling is far enough away from the main homestead so that guests can experience privacy and seclusion.

The architectually designed Tiny House has a mezzanine bedroom which accommodates 2 guests in a queen size bed. It has a kitchen so guests can either eat in or out and a BBQ. The large deck is ideal for alfresco dining or just to soak up the views and country air. There is a wall heater and a split system and due to the small space it heats and cools quickly.

Guest
neighborhood_overview:

There are many activities to take part in such as riding a bike along the bike trail or hiking one of the many walking tracks in and around the township.

host_about:
We proudly offer you a boutique selection of Rooms, Suites, Apartments and Cottages (many with water views) in beautiful, historic, Williamstown.

Rooms & Suites
Our lovely old home is just one door from the water, boat marina and restaurants and has been tastefully renovated and decorated so that every room has ensuites (some with spas) and most of the rooms also have gas log fires. One of the rooms has its own private lounge and balcony but other guests can enjoy the shared lounge room with fire and bay window.  

Apartments & Cottages
The apartments and cottages that we offer are dotted around Williamstown and most are an easy walk to the restaurants, yacht-clubs and shops. They vary from 1-4 bedrooms and 1-3 bathrooms. (One apartment even has a 4th toilet). 

We are not just offering a spare room in our house. This is our business and we are a dedicated team working to ensure that your stay is comfortable.  We are very careful about the apartments and cottages that we choose to take on and have refused many from owners wanting us to manage them.

Having said that, Williamstown is the oldest suburb in Melbourne and therefore some of the classic older apartments have décor such as shower over the bath. Whilst I would normally say no to venues like this, there are two apartments that have this but their other qualities so far outweigh that one negative and I quietly chip away at the owners in order for that to be changed.  I mention this because we want you to let us know if you have mobility issues so that we can suggest other venues for you. 

Other than beds (which are purchased to order and very comfortable!!), I love to buy antique and pre-loved furniture to fit certain venues and I have them restored using classic and sometimes quirky fabrics so you will not find a ‘hotel’ feel to our venues. Each one is quite different (some are Modern, some Victorian and some are Art-deco era). 

Re Dining: 

Breakfast: We provide a breakfast basket to guests staying in the apartments and cottages. Sadly due to restrictions related to covid, we do not currently offer breakfast in the main house so have reduced prices accordingly and our house-guests enjoy very good breakfasts in one of our many local cafes / restaurants, all within 2-4 minutes of here. (There are three places that we particularly recommend for a great breakfast).   There is however a table set in the bay window and you are welcome to use (Email hidden by Airbnb) plementary Tea, coffee and biscuits are provided in all venues. 

Dinner: There is an excellent choice of restaurants with a variety of cuisines all within walking distance to nearly all of the venues that we offer. 

I'm proud to say that we have won the last 7 awards for 'tourism' and/or 'hospitality' at the Hobsons Bay region Business excellence awards as well as taken out the People's Choice award for the state of Victoria twice in the last three awards. 

Most of our guests are businesspeople or travellers so you can be assured of a quiet, relaxing and private 'home award from home' experience. We want your accommodation to be comfortable and check-ins and check-outs easy so that you can get on with enjoying the reason that you are here.

We look forward to welcoming you to beautiful Williamstown. 

Best regards, 

Melissa and the team from Captains Retreat

host_about:
We proudly offer you a boutique selection of Rooms, Suites, Apartments and Cottages (many with water views) in beautiful, historic, Williamstown.

Rooms & Suites
Our lovely old home is just one door from the water, boat marina and restaurants and has been tastefully renovated and decorated so that every room has ensuites (some with spas) and most of the rooms also have gas log fires. One of the rooms has its own private lounge and balcony but other guests can enjoy the shared lounge room with fire and bay window.  

Apartments & Cottages
The apartments and cottages that we offer are dotted around Williamstown and most are an easy walk to the restaurants, yacht-clubs and shops. They vary from 1-4 bedrooms and 1-3 bathrooms. (One apartment even has a 4th toilet). 

We are not just offering a spare room in our house. This is our business and we are a dedicated team working to ensure that your stay is comfortable.  We are very careful about the apartments and cottages that we choose to take on and have refused many from owners wanting us to manage them.

Having said that, Williamstown is the oldest suburb in Melbourne and therefore some of the classic older apartments have décor such as shower over the bath. Whilst I would normally say no to venues like this, there are two apartments that have this but their other qualities so far outweigh that one negative and I quietly chip away at the owners in order for that to be changed.  I mention this because we want you to let us know if you have mobility issues so that we can suggest other venues for you. 

Other than beds (which are purchased to order and very comfortable!!), I love to buy antique and pre-loved furniture to fit certain venues and I have them restored using classic and sometimes quirky fabrics so you will not find a ‘hotel’ feel to our venues. Each one is quite different (some are Modern, some Victorian and some are Art-deco era). 

Re Dining: 

Breakfast: We provide a breakfast basket to guests staying in the apartments and cottages. Sadly due to restrictions related to covid, we do not currently offer breakfast in the main house so have reduced prices accordingly and our house-guests enjoy very good breakfasts in one of our many local cafes / restaurants, all within 2-4 minutes of here. (There are three places that we particularly recommend for a great breakfast).   There is however a table set in the bay window and you are welcome to use (Email hidden by Airbnb) plementary Tea, coffee and biscuits are provided in all venues. 

Dinner: There is an excellent choice of restaurants with a variety of cuisines all within walking distance to nearly all of the venues that we offer. 

I'm proud to say that we have won the last 7 awards for 'tourism' and/or 'hospitality' at the Hobsons Bay region Business excellence awards as well as taken out the People's Choice award for the state of Victoria twice in the last three awards. 

Most of our guests are businesspeople or travellers so you can be assured of a quiet, relaxing and private 'home award from home' experience. We want your accommodation to be comfortable and check-ins and check-outs easy so that you can get on with enjoying the reason that you are here.

We look forward to welcoming you to beautiful Williamstown. 

Best regards, 

Melissa and the team from Captains Retreat

Once known as Emerald Hill, it wouldn’t be a stretch to call South Melbourne one of the city’s gems. Characterised by heritage streetscapes with Victorian terraces and a village feel, it sits just two kilometres south of the CBD, has a beach nearby and a thriving food scene.

There’s also the suburb’s beating heart: the South Melbourne Market. Established in 1867, the red brick building bordered by cafes and fruit stalls has long been a go-to for locals and tourists alike.

“I just love the atmosphere, there’s always something happening,” says Agathe Kerr, originally from France and now one of the market’s traders. Her stall, Agathe Patisserie, has been a fixture of South Melbourne Market for 2½ years, with shoppers patiently enduring long queues for a chance to buy one of her croissants.

host_about:
I'm a busy professional running my own consulting business. 

I love my work and I work pretty hard so I'm usually either going to work functions or keeping pretty quiet during the week.  Over the weekend I am social - catching up with friends for dinner, drinks, movies or theatre. I often catch up with friends at one of our favourite local bars - The Dogs Bar.

I am well travelled and have spent a lot of time in France and Europe in particular. I generally like to stay for relatively long stays of at least a 2 weeks in any location so as I get a real sense of the place and its rhythm. I gravitate towards local bars, restaurants, galleries and parks when I travel. And as a rule I avoid tourist attractions because I think the heart of a place is in its people not in places where 1000s of other tourists flock.

I love meeting new people and learning about different cultures, philosophies and ways of life. I relish a good intelligent conversation.  I speak French (moderately) and would welcome French speaking guests. I'll help you practise your English if you allow me to practise my French. 

And like many St Kilda locals I am absolutely passionate about this area. And so I will love pointing you in the direction of our many great beaches, bars and restaurants. And on the odd occasion I might even join you.

PS. I'm triple vaccinated against Covid-19 and ask that all guests have proof of double vaccination (ideally triple).

host_about:
We proudly offer you a boutique selection of Rooms, Suites, Apartments and Cottages (many with water views) in beautiful, historic, Williamstown.

Rooms & Suites
Our lovely old home is just one door from the water, boat marina and restaurants and has been tastefully renovated and decorated so that every room has ensuites (some with spas) and most of the rooms also have gas log fires. One of the rooms has its own private lounge and balcony but other guests can enjoy the shared lounge room with fire and bay window.  

Apartments & Cottages
The apartments and cottages that we offer are dotted around Williamstown and most are an easy walk to the restaurants, yacht-clubs and shops. They vary from 1-4 bedrooms and 1-3 bathrooms. (One apartment even has a 4th toilet). 

We are not just offering a spare room in our house. This is our business and we are a dedicated team working to ensure that your stay is comfortable.  We are very careful about the apartments and cottages that we choose to take on and have refused many from owners wanting us to manage them.

Having said that, Williamstown is the oldest suburb in Melbourne and therefore some of the classic older apartments have décor such as shower over the bath. Whilst I would normally say no to venues like this, there are two apartments that have this but their other qualities so far outweigh that one negative and I quietly chip away at the owners in order for that to be changed.  I mention this because we want you to let us know if you have mobility issues so that we can suggest other venues for you. 

Other than beds (which are purchased to order and very comfortable!!), I love to buy antique and pre-loved furniture to fit certain venues and I have them restored using classic and sometimes quirky fabrics so you will not find a ‘hotel’ feel to our venues. Each one is quite different (some are Modern, some Victorian and some are Art-deco era). 

Re Dining: 

Breakfast: We provide a breakfast basket to guests staying in the apartments and cottages. Sadly due to restrictions related to covid, we do not currently offer breakfast in the main house so have reduced prices accordingly and our house-guests enjoy very good breakfasts in one of our many local cafes / restaurants, all within 2-4 minutes of here. (There are three places that we particularly recommend for a great breakfast).   There is however a table set in the bay window and you are welcome to use (Email hidden by Airbnb) plementary Tea, coffee and biscuits are provided in all venues. 

Dinner: There is an excellent choice of restaurants with a variety of cuisines all within walking distance to nearly all of the venues that we offer. 

I'm proud to say that we have won the last 7 awards for 'tourism' and/or 'hospitality' at the Hobsons Bay region Business excellence awards as well as taken out the People's Choice award for the state of Victoria twice in the last three awards. 

Most of our guests are businesspeople or travellers so you can be assured of a quiet, relaxing and private 'home award from home' experience. We want your accommodation to be comfortable and check-ins and check-outs easy so that you can get on with enjoying the reason that you are here.

We look forward to welcoming you to beautiful Williamstown. 

Best regards, 

Melissa and the team from Captains Retreat

Hey there you curious creatures! Time to share a little about ourselves. Mike was born and raised in New Zealand and I have a Greek background but am from a small country town in Victoria. Podcasts, Kindle, books, online courses...we love learning new things.

We will do our best to make your stay truly memorable in all the right ways and also can’t wait to be great guests if we happen to chance by your Airbnb in your little corner of the globe. 

One more thought to take with you wherever you may be...

We Travel Not To Escape Life, But For Life Not To Escape Us.

See you very soon!


Mike & Panagiota x

host_about:
We're Klaudia (Sanctuary Artist), Jonathan (The Oracle), Maria (Fairy Godmother) and Tony (Maker of Worlds), a multi-cultural family all living in Melbourne. We're all different in many ways, but we all share one thing in common: a passion for unique and magical experiences. 

We have long since wished there were easy ways to escape our busy city lives and retreat into a magical, beautiful and peaceful space that feels like another world. This idea eventually evolved into a mission to build with our own hands Melbourne's very own magical sanctuaries and to share it with the rest of the world.

We love imagining what we could create, to build, and to share them with the world through hosting. We constantly think about how to make our creations bring an even greater sense of joy and wonder, and not about how much it'll cost us. We're genuinely excited and happy to host each new guest, to hear about what they love about our creations, and what we could do to make it even better.

We have built and opened our first three installments of Melbourne's hidden sanctuary, which we lovingly refer to as "Heaven & Earth", "Little world of Ice & Snow" and "Mini Renaissance". We have plans to make it even better, as well as other ideas for other worlds we want to try building for our next installments.

We invite you to step into one of our hidden sanctuaries, to follow our journey on social media, and to watch and help us grow by sharing what you think!

This is the evolution of urban renewal in Melbourne ...... and then .......   watch this space -  Smallfootprint homes and products that reflect our need for simplicity and comfort . Always remember to tread lightly ,  help our movement grow and let’s look after our planet earth - remembering healthy planets are hard to find . 

Hoping we can welcome you soon .

Hey there you curious creatures! Time to share a little about ourselves. Mike was born and raised in New Zealand and I have a Greek background but am from a small country town in Victoria. Would you believe that in all the time we’ve been together, I haven’t been able to convince Mike to do the HAKA for me? I graduated and practiced as a Podiatrist for a couple of years, before moving into the advertising industry, security risk management and recently a furniture design & importing business. We launched our hosting journey as a way to help others create unforgettable experiences during their travels whilst having the freedom to personally explore more of our amazing world at the same time!

We’re both fans of entrepreneurship, love Gary Vaynerchuck (if you’ve never heard of him, do yourself a favour and look him up) and enjoy studying personal development, online business, the sharing economy and anything that piques our interest at the time. We Travel Not To Escape Life, But For Life Not To Escape Us.

neighborhood_overview:
Selby is a suburb 37 km south-east from Melbourne’ CBD. It is situated on the fringe of metropolitan Melbourne outside the Urban Growth Boundary (so called Green Wedge Zone). It is an unique environment that has the convenience of urban living but with the serenity of rural feature. The area consists mostly of rolling hills, steeply weathered valleys and gullies covered in thick temperate rainforest, predominantly of tall gum trees and dense ferny undergrowth.

We’ve been living here for over 10 years and enjoy such semi rural lifestyle very much. We think our guests will love such experience too, especially for city dwellers wanting a few days away from the hustle and bustle of busy city life.
